about: Springwater Township is a rural municipality in Simcoe County, Ontario, wrapping around Barrie’s north and west edges toward Midhurst, Elmvale, and Minesing. Villages and farm country sit among wetlands and the Minesing Wetlands rather than forming a continuous city. Highway 26 and County Road corridors link residents to Barrie and Georgian Bay. About 22,000 people live in Springwater Township.
